summary: The new profiling script has a verified run-stopping defect: it requests `target` from `temp_tgt.dta`, but the producing script saves that dataset before generating `target`. Fix that first; otherwise the promised Markdown output cannot be created. The grouping, recodes, and non-missing share arithmetic are otherwise sound, but the new analysis also lacks a portable, master-driven replication path.

findings.title: The input dataset is saved before `target` is generated, so the new script stops at its first `use`
findings.what_the_code_does: The new script executes `use linked_before linked_after age target ... using temp_tgt.dta`. Its producer executes `save ... temp`sfx'.dta` at line 119 and only later executes `gen target=!(namefrst==fs_namefrst & namelast==fs_namelast)` at line 138. Thus `temp_tgt.dta` does not contain the variable needed for the intended target-share calculation at lines 65-66.
findings.why_it_matters: Stata will stop with `variable target not found`, before any groups or shares are calculated, and `MATCHING/results/linked_groups_socio.md` will not be written.
findings.how_to_check: Run `describe target using "$REP_SNU/enum_date/DATA/INTERMEDIATE/temp_tgt.dta"` in Stata, or run the command documented at MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do:21 and observe the failure at line 30.
findings.suggested_fix: Either generate `target` before saving `temp_tgt.dta`, or load the four Ancestry/FamilySearch name fields in `linked_groups_socio.do` and recreate `target` there with the same definition. Then rerun the existing N and linkage-rate gates.

findings.title: The documented standalone run is checkout-specific and the new analysis is absent from the replication master
findings.what_the_code_does: The documented command invokes `Run-Stata.ps1`, whose wrapper only executes the requested do-file. With `$REP_REPO` unset, the do-file then loads `D:/repos/fixing_transcription_errors/replication/config.do`; it also assumes that a prior manual `_figs_tgt_run.do` invocation has created `temp_tgt.dta`. The replication master's script list does not build the target-only input or run this new analysis.
findings.why_it_matters: A clean clone outside the author's exact checkout cannot reproduce the new Markdown table from the documented command, and the main replication run silently omits it. This is a broken clean-run path even after the correctness defect is fixed.
findings.how_to_check: Clear `$REP_REPO` and invoke the documented command from a checkout not located at `D:/repos/fixing_transcription_errors`; it will fail loading the hardcoded config. Also run `rg -n "linked_groups_socio|_figs_tgt_run" replication/run_machineA.do` and confirm neither prerequisite nor analysis is called.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide an orchestrator that loads configuration relative to the resolved repository root, runs `_figs_tgt_run.do`, and then runs `linked_groups_socio.do`; add that sequence to the replication master if this output is part of the submission archive.

verified_clean.item: The four link-status groups form an exhaustive partition once the binary assertions pass.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do:38 verifies both flags are non-missing binary values; line 58 maps all four combinations, and line 70 checks that their counts sum to `_N`.

verified_clean.item: The socio-demographic variable list and recodes match the active Figure 4 analysis.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do:28 and :42-56 match the active loop and recodes at CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:317-352 and :365.

verified_clean.item: Category shares use the stated within-group, non-missing denominators.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do:77-87 counts `!missing(v)` separately for each group and divides each category count by that group-variable denominator; equality to a finite category does not admit Stata missing values.

verified_clean.item: The linkage-rate provenance gates reproduce the checked-in target-only raw values.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do:33-37 checks N and both rates against MATCHING/results/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex:8-10.

verified_clean.item: The changed analysis makes a descriptive link-status comparison rather than encoding a causal estimand.
verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do:1-15 defines the work as a profile of the table sample and explicitly describes all four status groups and conditional shares.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied, so claims-vs-code could not compare manuscript language or reported paper numbers against the implementation.

The external Stata data, including `temp_tgt.dta`, were not readable in this review and the Stata pipeline was not run; data-dependent distributions and runtime behavior beyond the traced source logic remain unverified.
The uncommitted slide-review report refers to an external Overleaf deck that was not supplied; it was treated as a review artifact, not as the paper draft.
This was a diff-scoped review. Unchanged files were inspected only where needed to trace the new code's inputs, labels, and replication entry points.
